nom: Mario Badescu Drying Patch Pimple Patches

segments.oily: One reviewer with naturally oily skin developed an allergic reaction, with dry red patches, after using these alongside other products from the same skincare line.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin report the patches worked and showed a visible difference overnight, though one notes the brand's drying lotion is generally a bit tough on her skin by comparison.

concerns.blemishes: Reviewers are sharply split: a very large share say the patches did nothing at all, with no flattening, extraction, or visible change, while another substantial group, several using them specifically on cystic or nodular breakouts, report blemishes reduced or cleared within one to three days; some attribute the split to this being a salicylic-acid patch rather than a hydrocolloid one, so it won't pull out gunk the way hydrocolloid patches do.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers say the patches reduce redness and swelling around a blemish, crediting the niacinamide in the formula; others report the opposite, including more redness and irritation, a red circle left after use on hormonal neck breakouts, and one allergic reaction with red patches spreading across the face.
concerns.spots: One reviewer says the patches seemed to leave her pimples more prone to scarring than regular hydrocolloid patches do.
concerns.dehydration: One reviewer credits the hyaluronic acid in the formula with avoiding dryness, while another felt the main drying effect was simply being unable to moisturize the treated area.

aspects.libelle: Doesn't stick or falls off quickly
Sticks well and stays on overnight
Nearly invisible, wearable during the day
Multi-patch strip is messy to peel apart

extraits.texte: Never in my life have I've gotten an allergic reaction to any skincare products, and I've used many! Went to buy some products last sale and was recommended these by a worker. Should've checked reviews before buying this or any product from this brand cause it gave me my first allergic reaction. I currently have dry red patches all over my face. Keep in mind i bought this, the vitamin c serum and the dew cream from the same brand. Only used the serum once so that wasn't what messed up my face. After days of using the moisturizer, which burned my face after i was trying to use it to help my skin cause it was starting to get dry I realized that the red patches i was getting where near where i had these patches on a couple of times. So lesson learned. Ive always felt uncomfortable w the thought of returning skincare/makeup products but i will definitely be returning this and using the money on something to help get my skin back to normal. For something like this to happen to my naturally oily skin is insane.

I put them on at night and theres always a noticable differnce in the morning. I have sensitive skin, but have always used the drying lotion even though it's a little tough on my face. Shocked at all the reviews saying they dont stay on bc i have to get them off with my nails! Also, these are truly invisible if you want to wear them out.

I've used these on some of the under-the-skin, cystic type breakouts. It has helped either to calm them back down so they go away, or come to a head quicker so they can go away. I found if I use them on any hormonal breakouts I get on my neck, it will cause a red circle which isn't great. Everywhere else it doesn't cause that reaction.

extraits.titre: Don't confuse these with Hydrocolloid patches
extraits.texte: These patches work! It's basically their tride and true drying lotion in a bottle. I think a lot of the reviews saying they don't work are expecting the effects of a hydrocolloid patch and that's just not what this is. This patch is formulared with Salicylic acid, hyaluronic acid and Niacinamide. Hydrocolloid is not one of the ingredients therefore this will not pull the gunk out of your pimple like those do. In my opinion, these are better. The salicylic acid dries the pimple, the niacinamide deminishes the redness and the hyaluronic acid helps avoid dryness. You will notice the appearance of your pimple minimizes when you remove it. I put them on over my skin care. However, I would recommend you let your skin care absorb and dry down before putting it on to avoid slipping. They're also shockingly undetectable because they are thin. These absolutely work & they work FAST!

extraits.titre: Wanted to love, but I don't
extraits.texte: I used to love the drying lotion but hate how fast the bottle would dry out. These just don't work as well and I feel like they cause my pimples to scar more than regular hydrocolloid patches do. They dry up the pimple okay, but not quick enough for the price either. I won't be repurchasing

I had high hopes but the only "drying" happening for me was the deprivation of moisturizer I'd otherwise be apply to the area. Starting with the cons because these are a no for me. Cons: little to no redness reduction or minimizing, does little to actually dry zits, and you're probably going to use five at a time due to poor packing Pros: they're very secure and will stay almost anywhere (pesky nostril/edge of lip zits), they're almost unnoticeable on

This helped me tremendously for my nodule/cystic pimples. If you have a white head pimple, I would recommend a Hero or hydrocolloid patch. But this is great for those huge nodules or hard nodular pimples! Give it time. Try it at least three times before you decide to move to the next regimen. But i'm telling you, this works to minimize the size
